No client binaries executed, no client modifications, no challenge replay, no synthetic GameGuard reply, no credential/session/body values exported.

gameguard_launcher.packing_assessment: Zero-raw TEXT with substantial virtual allocation, high-entropy DATA, entry point near its end, and minimal imports strongly indicate a packed loader. No named packer is established.
gameguard_launcher.api_limit: No exported startup, query, challenge-generation or authentication-check API is exposed by this executable. Its metadata identifies a client launcher, not a server authentication component.

other_local_observations.historical_patch_manifest_caveat: This size differs from both identical supplied 2541208-byte files. The historical manifest does not establish corruption or a missing update.

folder_inventory_limit: Names and sizes alone do not identify exported APIs or establish that any listed module implements the game-server authentication role. Monitors and drivers have not been executed or analyzed here.

protocol.header: type big-endian u16, total frame length big-endian u16, action little-endian u16
protocol.size_difference_conclusion: The captured68-byte reply and reference84-byte reply share the same length-prefixed wrapper; the opaque blobs differ in length60 versus76. The sixteen-byte difference does not identify algorithm, version, structure or validity.
protocol.pinned_source_limit: GameGuard.cs sends one fixed84-byte literal; it contains no challenge generator, verifier, SDK call, session state or vendor structure definition. The dispatcher handles only the initial0x80 request.
protocol.capture_limit: Only one initial server GameGuard reply is available. Stability, freshness, session dependence and blob-generation rules are not established.

verified_local_test.interpretation: The local test reached the GameGuard initialization request, then intentionally closed without supplying its response. This explains the unimplemented protocol step, but does not independently establish the exact internal cause of the user-reported Start Null Error or prove installation damage.

primary_source_context.summary: The official product description describes server/client authentication and separate server-authentication modules. It does not publish the exact Rumble Fighter blob schema or establish that a particular server SDK is indispensable to this build.
